# Emdash Skills — AI + Human Entrypoint (start here)

> Solo-founder product-building OS for Cloudflare Workers: one-line prompts → deployed products. 23 skill categories · 160 doctrinal rules (`rules/`) · 149 reference docs · 28 agents · 36 templates · 34 commands. Load the SMALLEST useful subset per the router below — never the whole mesh.

> Full unabridged index: [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt) · Human README: [README.md](README.md)

## Routing spine (how to load the minimal set)

- [Router](_router.md) — prompt → smallest useful skill set (category map · task routing · file hints)
- [Skill Packs](_packs/README.md) — grouped bundles (core / frontend / backend / testing / design / …); one pack loads its whole graph
- [Kernel](_kernel/index.md) — canonical shared definitions (WCAG · OWASP · CWV · brand · stack · model IDs); cite by anchor, never restate
- [Skill Profiles](SKILL_PROFILES.md) — default bundle by product type (SaaS · marketing · nonprofit · API · …)
- [Routing Matrix](routing-matrix.md) — where every new lesson is routed
- [Operating Doctrine](AGENTSKILLS.md) · [Conventions](CONVENTIONS.md) — durable stance + stack defaults/constants
- **Doctrinal rules** — 160 always-/pack-loaded rules in `rules/` (autonomy · verification · security · feature-flags · payments · …); routed via the Router's “Doctrinal principles” + pack lists
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md) — package history
